strings.en:
{1c:17}You would praise useless effort that
bears no fruit? Nearly dying was plainly a
self-inflicted blunder.{1a}Offering kind words to such a person
may be meant as kindness, but it may
invite unfortunate misunderstandings.{1a}I nearly died working so hard for your
sake... or some such. What would you do
if that were held over you later?{0c:2b51091501}

What would you do if that were held over you later?
But...
A joke, of course. [1][HERO]-san would never say such a thing, surely.
